integrity_statement: The analytic proof gives an exact sum-of-squares certificate and finite-group averaging; the included exact-arithmetic checker corroborates finite identities. No independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to real, homogeneous degree-two Walsh chaos with five independent signs and the L4 norm; other exponents, complex scalars and different counts are not addressed. Historical bibliographic equivalence cannot be excluded absolutely.
title: Sharp fourth moments and Euclidean distance of the five-sign quadratic Walsh chaos
